headline: Crude Oil Prices Rise on Escalating Middle East Tensions
summary: Crude oil prices traded near recent highs as energy markets prepared for potential US and Israeli strikes on Iran following upcoming elections.
why: Geopolitical conflict in the Middle East poses risks to international crude oil supply routes and global energy benchmarks.

impacts.name: Brent Crude
impacts.why: Heightened risks of military conflict in key oil-exporting regions spur risk premiums in global energy markets.

why_moved: Supply disruption concerns in key oil-producing regions pushed crude futures higher ahead of expected military actions.
